original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Guarded-byte Boolean differences for bounded Gaussian Newton membership, with exact first-failure preservation on ranks 0 through 9 and absolute component bit lengths at most 8192.
scope_change_reason: The general replay-runtime card is narrowed to a new arithmetic algorithm for one public validator, with full source replay preservation and separately measured complete API and replay costs. No scientific result or decoded coefficient is cached.
bottleneck_link: This is verifier engineering for the P104 entrance check, not a change to the binding complex supplier or its physical validation bill.
stop_rule: Stop after the first verified packed implementation. Do not extend the rank domain, native collector, physical caller or kappa calculation.
evidence: PROOF.md, packed.py, verify.py, PERFORMANCE.md and complete reference replay through an opt-in adapter.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can a physical membership-only consumer profit from guarded-lane batching after all input, movement and restoration costs?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The logical API improvement does not change the paid supplier bill by itself.
open_questions.first_step: Name an actual consumer whose only output is membership, and price input acquisition and the complete validation scan.
open_questions.blocked_by: No physical caller, allocation or tape implementation is supplied.

open_questions.question: Can source replay input validation and independent decoder work be reduced while retaining their complete diagnostics?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Those unchanged operations limit the end-to-end effect of the new transform.
open_questions.first_step: Profile a complete source replay and isolate one separately source-bound replacement.
open_questions.blocked_by: The present change intentionally replaces only the bounded membership algorithm.
